lines: Ashwini Amit Dixit, Promoter Group Selling Shareholder, may sell up to 67,500 shares, worth up to ₹9.13 crore if all offered shares are sold.
Their proceeds from the offer are up to ₹9.13 crore; actual proceeds are slightly lower as employee-portion shares sell at a discount.
The shares were unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, a recent trigger 66 days ago, though the unlock is of shares, not cash.
Family link: shares the surname Dixit with Amit Arun Dixit, whose first name matches the middle name of Ashwini Amit Dixit.
